name: Rotorjack
behaviour: Hovers four metres up, out of reach from the ground until it dives or the hero jumps. Strafes down a telegraphed lane dropping proximity mines (and drops low and exposed as it pulls up), calls a searchlight that marks the hero and rallies and commands every machine nearby, and rakes a lit hero with its cannon. Rare patrol sweeps bring extra gyrocopters in from the edge of the grid.
look: Orange-hulled gyrocopter with a glass cockpit, a spinning rotor, a tail boom and a searchlight under the nose.
